$comment: Canonical Openfund status (docs/status/README.md is generated from this file by `node scripts/docs/status.mjs`; `npm run docs:check` validates both). Every state is recorded per environment. Source states come from Git; runtime states (deployed, enabled, verified, accepted) are valid only with `verifiedAt` and `evidence`. CI never probes production: a stale or wrong runtime claim must be corrected by re-verifying, not by editing the date.
